messages.text: Did the premium on CPI days hold in both periods?

In this sample, the median CPI premium was +0.446 pp in the earlier period (n 5) and +0.247 pp in the later period (n 8).

Pooled, it is +0.389 pp (n 13), on a baseline of 0.594%.

- These are the page's own numbers, read from event_premium.
- That describes what was priced in. It does not say whether buying or selling options paid.

In the real terminal, this answer comes from the real tables. Here it is an invented example.
Should I sell options before the next CPI?
I can't advise on trades. I can show how past CPI days were priced, with their n and caveats, and one event proves nothing on its own.
